verdictMeaning: The supplied independent auditor is adequate for the specified fixed-reader/output fidelity check. This verdict does not report a successful audit of the real A/B files; that execution remains pending in CI.
blindComparison: No blind comparison, preference, game-quality judgment, E9 completion, or actual-play claim. This is a source-aware review of an acquisition audit method.

method.independentParsing: Build source field/graph ledgers; consume the actual readable document, locate each encountered node by its parsed ID, read original-length value spans, and build an observed ledger from parsed labels/metadata. No formatter import, formatter execution, or reconstructed expected document.
method.prose: After production Buffer UTF-8 roundtrip checks, every text, mood, tag, locked_reason and alternate string must match its original exact string span with its separator LF. Empty strings remain required fields. Marker-looking lines within original values are consumed as prose, not parsed as metadata.
method.graph: Every subject, unit, boundary note, entry sequence, node ID, speaker, effective boolean flag, ordered alternate variant/state pair, and ordered continuation sequence is checked. Repeated edges are preserved. Required fields and nodes cannot be omitted, repeated or substituted; trailing output fails.
method.nullRouting: A null text node must have the routing marker and is counted as a graph node and null_routing, not as an authored string. No inferred missing field is created for null.
method.order: Display node order may differ from raw storage. For player_option IDs with a present N... parent and C-number suffix, the parent must occur first. Entries and continuations remain authoritative; numeric display order is not asserted to be execution order.
method.publication: Public output contains aggregate counts, whole-input/output hashes, aggregate field/graph ledger hashes, status, fixed error codes and this static scope. No original text, per-field prose, speaker labels, node IDs, exception messages or stacks are emitted.
method.failures: The case loop continues to B if A fails. Any case failure keeps the overall result and exit code failed. Report-write failure also leaves nonzero exitCode. No process.exit is used.

verification.environment: Pure in-memory JavaScript through functions.exec only; no local process, server, browser or real CI run.

covers: option stored before parent but displayed after it

verification.limits: Synthetic parser tests used a clearly labelled noncryptographic fixture digest; CLI simulations used mocked Buffer/filesystem/crypto boundaries. These tests establish parser equality/rejection and branch/error-output behavior, not Node built-in correctness or actual private-input success. Production uses node:crypto SHA-256 and real Buffer UTF-8 byte roundtrips.
verification.staticCorrectionBeforeFirstTest: Replaced numeric header-prefix slice offsets with literal prefix.length, including correction of the AUTHORED FLAGS prefix offset. The first executed positive fixture passed; no failed executed test was discarded.

upstreamEvidenceReportedByCoordinator.countInterpretation: 1337 minus 420 null text nodes gives 917 original text strings; adding 40 alternate strings gives 957. The earlier total that counted null routing slots is not evidence of prose loss.
upstreamEvidenceReportedByCoordinator.provenance: Parent task report only. This reviewer did not independently read those private outputs or execute their audit.

remainingMeasuredResult: Run node tools/audit-e9-readable.mjs after preparation. Its real cases must pass, including every actual alternate and graph record; inspect resulting counts and input/output hashes. No current real-input PASS is asserted here.
scopeLimits: Fixed reader fidelity only; does not prove that the reader itself contains every original DB/game-source condition.
Effective false flags are reconstructed from absence of a true marker; no runtime unconditional-availability claim.
No product edits, benchmark changes, new mandatory role or new comparison stage.
Independent refutation of this script is not represented as completed.
